'''Legal Division''' was a branch of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. One of the larger divisions, it worked closely with [[Media Division]]. All legal disputes between the Authority and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] were handled by the Legal Divisions, and represented Authority interests in Imperial courts. The [[Administrator/Legends|administrators]] within the Legal Division took great lengths to avoid antagonizing the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] of the adjacent [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. Subdivisions included [[Inter-Corporate Tribunal]] and [[Sector/Imperial Liaison]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
